viking_simulator.title: Sequential Queue Engine (Wave Cap)
viking_simulator.tooltip_desc: The simulator processes attacks by class. If the wave depletes before a class attacks, remaining troops will score 0 kills.
viking_simulator.rule_1: This engine replicates the real combat algorithm of the game based on three golden rules:
viking_simulator.rule_2: Zero-Sum Pool: You cannot kill more enemies than actually spawned in the wave.
viking_simulator.rule_3: Class Queue: Attacks are not simultaneous, but happen in order: Infantry → Cavalry → Archers.
viking_simulator.rule_4: Spillover: If the enemy "Cap" is reached during a class's turn (e.g., Infantry), subsequent classes will have no available targets, scoring 0 kills (Host zero-kill phenomenon).
viking_simulator.thermometer_desc: This table compares the mathematical prediction of the simulator with the real kills registered by the Alliance. If a wave was not played, the prediction is based on the rally composition selected above.

viking_tier_efficiency.title: 📈 Real Tier Efficiency by Troop Type
viking_tier_efficiency.description: Analysis based on synchronous maximum peaks of the event. Extreme jumps between low and high Tiers are due to Survived Waves: players with high Tiers survive longer and gather the massive enemy pool of the final phases.
